title: hieracium florentinum subsp. michelii
intro: Hieracium florentinum subsp. michelii, commonly known as Devil's-bit scabious, is a flowering plant species within the dandelion family. It is used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe skin irritations, reduce pain, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Devil's-bit scabious include its ability to act as a vulnerary, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful for wound healing, skin conditions, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
